school_name: Delaware College of Art and Design
closure_type_basis: MSCHE reports that DCAD announced closure and closed as an institution on July 31, 2024; transfer and teach-out options do not make Pratt a successor institution.
operations_ceased_basis: MSCHE closure FAQ states that the institution closed July 31, 2024.
parent_continued_basis: No structured evidence that DCAD's institution continued under another identifier.
date_basis: MSCHE-reported institutional closure date; FSA administrative date retained separately.
editor_note: Corrects prior unsupported Pratt merger description.

school_name: Watkins College of Art, Design & Film
closure_type_basis: Belmont and Watkins announced a merger effective for Fall 2020; Watkins programs and students continued at Belmont as the Watkins College of Art.
operations_ceased_basis: The former standalone Watkins operation and campus ended after the 2019-20 academic year.
parent_continued_basis: Watkins academic programs and students continued through Belmont University.
date_basis: Excluded merger; no public closure date selected.
editor_note: Confirmed operational continuity, so excluded from institution-closure totals.

closure_type_basis: Mount Ida College closed; UMass Amherst acquired the land and buildings and adopted selected programs. Asset, campus, records, and student transfers do not mean Mount Ida continued as an institution.
operations_ceased_basis: UMass Amherst's institutional history states that Mount Ida closed its doors May 17, 2018.
parent_continued_basis: Mount Ida ceased as an institution; UMass acquired assets rather than continuing Mount Ida under a replacement identifier.
date_basis: UMass Amherst-reported operational closure date; FSA administrative date retained separately.
editor_note: Corrects prior unsupported University of Rhode Island/Assumption successor descriptions.

closure_type_basis: EDS ceased granting its own degrees and Cambridge operations ended, but EDS remained a separate legal entity and continued its mission through an affiliation with Union Theological Seminary.
operations_ceased_basis: EDS's Cambridge campus operations ceased after the 2016-17 academic year.
parent_continued_basis: EDS continued as EDS at Union; Union granted the degrees and EDS remained a legal entity.
date_basis: Excluded affiliation/continuation; no public closure date selected.
editor_note: Classified as affiliation and degree-granting cessation rather than full institutional closure.

school_name: East San Gabriel Valley ROP and Technical Center
closure_type_basis: Regional Occupational Program operated under a joint powers agreement of K-12 school districts (CDE lists member unified school districts); a district career-tech program, not a college.
editor_note: IPEDS codes it public 2-year (sector 4), so the sector-7 rule misses it; excluded like other district career-tech programs.

closure_type_basis: Grades 9-12 career and technical center of the St. Joseph School District; a district career-tech program, not a college.
editor_note: IPEDS codes it public 2-year (sector 4), so the sector-7 rule misses it; excluded like other district career-tech programs.

closure_type_basis: Adult and career education site run by the School District of Palm Beach County; a district program, not a college.
editor_note: IPEDS codes it public 2-year (sector 4), so the sector-7 rule misses it; excluded like other district career-tech programs.

closure_type_basis: Merged into Ashford University: Bridgepoint Education announced the merger finalized in October 2018; Rockies programs were approved for federal aid at Ashford effective Oct. 5, 2018 and its doctoral programs continued under the Ashford name.
operations_ceased_basis: The Department of Education closed the University of the Rockies record on Oct. 29, 2018.
parent_continued_basis: Programs and students continued at Ashford University.
editor_note: Merger, not a closure (confirmed by editor 2026-11-11). IPEDS shows it as closed (status D), not combined, so the automatic rule could not catch it.

closure_type_basis: Massachusetts Department of Higher Education lists the reason as "Merger (1997)"; transcripts are held by Worcester Technical High School (Worcester Public Schools).
operations_ceased_basis: Standalone institute ended with the 1997 merger.
parent_continued_basis: Records and operations continued under Worcester Technical High School.
editor_note: Merger into a school-district high school (confirmed by editor 2026-11-11).
